title: Budget Billing Installment Calculation and Review Method
content:
# Budget Billing Installment Calculation and Review Method

**Method.** Levelized plans set the installment every bill to the 12-bill average of actual charges plus the deferred balance divided by the plan's spread period in months. Budget plans set it to projected weather-normalized charges for the next 12 months divided by 12 and review it every scheduled review period of the plan, keeping the current installment when the recomputed one differs by less than the plan's review threshold, and review it at once when the deferred balance reaches the plan's review trigger in absolute value or the schedule's rates change. FlatBill plans set the amount once per term from predicted usage priced at current rates plus the plan's FlatBill risk premium, and reprice it only after a usage-band breach or at renewal. Every installment is rounded up to the next whole dollar and never set below the plan's installment floor.

## 1. The 12-bill average of actual charges

The 12-bill average is the mean of the amounts of the agreement's 12 most recent regular service bills dated before the review or enrollment date, rounded to the cent. Where the agreement has fewer regular bills at the address than the plan's history requirement, the plan's basis for a short history applies instead of the average.

## 2. Levelized installment

The levelized installment is the higher of the plan's installment floor and the following amount rounded up to the next whole dollar: the 12-bill average, plus the deferred balance divided by the plan's spread period in months. The division is added to the average before any rounding; the sum is rounded up once; the floor is applied to the rounded figure. A deferred balance owed by the customer raises the installment, and a balance in the customer's favour lowers it. Where the spread period is 0 months, no part of the deferred balance enters the installment.

| Hypothetical case (spread period 12 months) | 12-bill average | Deferred balance | Share of the balance | Sum | Rounded up | Floor | Installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | $143.57 | $86.40 owed | $7.20 | $150.77 | $151 | $25.00 | $151 |
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | $143.57 | $300.00 in the customer's favour | less $25.00 | $118.57 | $119 | $25.00 | $119 |
| Residential Levelized Billing Plan | $18.20 | $30.00 in the customer's favour | less $2.50 | $15.70 | $16 | $25.00 | $25 |
| Commercial Levelized Billing Plan | $612.40 | $1,140.00 owed | $95.00 | $707.40 | $708 | $50.00 | $708 |

## 3. Budget installment

The budget installment is the projected weather-normalized charges for the next 12 months divided by 12, rounded up to the next whole dollar, and never below the plan's floor. It is reviewed on the plan's schedule of reviews; at a scheduled review the current installment is kept when the recomputed installment differs from it by less than the plan's threshold fraction of the current installment, and is otherwise reset. It is reviewed at once when the deferred balance reaches the plan's review trigger in absolute value, or when the rates of the agreement's schedule change.

*Hypothetical:* projected weather-normalized charges of $1,621.00 for the next 12 months give $135.0833, rounded up to $136, above the floor; the installment is $136.

## 4. FlatBill amount

The FlatBill amount is the predicted weather-normalized 12-month charges at current rates, multiplied by one plus the plan's FlatBill risk premium, divided by 12, rounded up to the next whole dollar, and never below the plan's floor. It is set once for the term, together with the predicted 12-month usage it rests on and the last day of the term. Within a term it changes only by repricing after a usage-band breach; a new amount is otherwise set only at renewal.

| Hypothetical case | Predicted 12-month charges | Premium | With premium | Divided by 12 | FlatBill amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Residential FlatBill Plan | $1,476.00 | 4% | $1,535.04 | $127.92 | $128 |
| Small Business FlatBill Plan | $5,232.00 | 5% | $5,493.60 | $457.80 | $458 |

## 5. Rounding and floor on every plan

On every plan the installment is a whole-dollar figure obtained by rounding up, and the floor applies after rounding: a computed $49.10 on the Commercial Budget Billing Plan rounds up to $50 and meets the $50.00 floor; a computed $41.00 is set at $50. (Hypothetical computed amounts.)
